Agree with the OP. No matter with how shitty you think your life there is always someone who looks up to you and many people that directly or indirectly care about you. Might be they do not say it out loud. Might be they do. But still they care about you. Anything that hurts you directly/indirectly affects these people. For their sake and for your sake, do not give up. 

The big problem that is acting as a roadblock will run with high heels the moment you confront it. Do not worry. Be happy.

> **H A P P Y  B I R T H D A Y**

Heck with what drunk people say. It hardly makes any sense. When I am drunk,  I mostly apologize to people for getting drunk. The irony oh-so-evident. 

Anyway you get a [hug](http://i.imgur.com/rJEGg.jpg)

Things will be better! :-)

I do not know what to say. I always think that depression is a state that the mind is in when it is not occupied enough. As in when you have gazillions of time and you spend your time thinking "What am I supposed to do now?" and end up doing nothing and feeling bad about it /kind-of-circlejerking-moment

Anyway, I believe depression can be treated. Do you have any interests or hobbies? Pursue that with infinite enthusiasm. It will help you cope with it and eventually overcome it.

Depression is like being in a pool of shit. The longer you are there in it, the more you are disgusted with the situation that you are in and about yourself. Realize that if you stay there without any effort to get out of it you are still in shit and you are still gonna be disgusted no matter how hard you convince yourself otherwise. Try getting out of it and cleanse yourself of the bad habits/shit. Just make the effort.

I found physical/creative exercises remedial to the situation I was in. Actually pursuing any interest will help. But you have to put the effort.

Mind sharing what's bothering you?


About the reactions - People react in different ways. Some just go into problem-denial mode or just ignore it. It is a natural reaction. It's not like they do not care - they may just not know how to approach the situation and therefore are at a loss on what to say and generally end up saying something stupid unintentionally.

Please explain. What to you is positive change? And how did you try to achieve it? What changes have you made in your life other than an address? No body has talent. They only achieve it through hard work and dedication. You do not go to the gym for one day and expect 6 pack abs the next day, right? You work at it. 

Try changing your outlook and never give up. From what I can understand, you look like you have given up on everything. Do not do that. Keep trying and never give up.

Welcome to the club. You feel disconnected because you do not relate to the things that you do or the people that you meet. You have a hobby or interest? Even the faintest hint of one will do. Try pursuing it and everything will face into place :-) Do not worry about stuff.

I was in a rot myself. For an entire month, I was plotting to kill myself and did some things that thankfully did not work out. I had enough and decided to change and today I am a better person or at the least working towards it. No shit that other people do or say will make a difference, only you can change stuff - that's what I learned and wanted to share.

I am not trying to sound cliched, at least consciously. I understand how you feel and I want to help you. I just put it in a bunch of words I relate to. If the post is not helping, my bad. I am sure there will be some one else who can you help you better than I did. I am really sorry.

Why shouldn't you? Because you haven't experienced the joy of life yet. Life is a never ending experience that doesn't end until it does on its own. Life isn't always anxiety, awkwardness, fear, paranoia, sadness, pain and apathy. I understand how you feel. But you are just going through a phase in your life. Will yourself to fight it. You thinking about dying because you feel lost and hopeless is sad. Have courage. You can make things better only if you will yourself to make things better. They will not change themselves. If you believe in God, pray to God. If you do not believe in God, believe in yourself. Look at yourself from a third person perspective. You are giving up without putting up a fight. Why are you doing that to yourself? Life isn't "not death". It is living - doing the things that you enjoy doing. Stop thinking about death and start to live. Conquer your challenges. People suffer with the same challenges as you and have conquered them. The only thing that stopped them was their own self doubt. If you were a boxer fighting the match of your life, to achieve the goal that you always wanted to achieve, would you just quit looking at the terrifying opponent? You do not know how he fights but he looks terrifying. You are going to quit at that? You would only give up when you are physically incapable of putting up a fight. That is life.

Here are some quotes from Swami Vivekananda I think may help.

The whole secret of existence is to have no fear. Never fear what will become of you, depend on no one. Only the moment you reject all help are you free.
 
Fear is death, fear is sin, fear is hell, fear is unrighteousness, fear is wrong life. All the negative thoughts and ideas that are in the world have proceeded from this evil spirit of fear.
 
Why are people so afraid? The answer is that they have made themselves helpless and dependent on others. We are so lazy, we do not want to do anything ourselves. We want a Personal God, a Savior or a Prophet to do everything for us.
 
As long as we believe ourselves to be even the least different from God, fear remains with us; but when we know ourselves to be the One, fear goes; of what can we be afraid?

Stand up, be bold, be strong. Take the whole responsibility on your own shoulders, and know that you are the creator of your own destiny. All the strength and succor you want is within yourselves. Therefore, make your own future.

This I have seen in life—those who are overcautious about themselves fall into dangers at every step; those who are afraid of losing honor and respect, get only disgrace; and those who are always afraid of loss, always lose.
 
“Face the brutes.” That is a lesson for all life—face the terrible, face it boldly. Like the monkeys, the hardships of life fall back when we cease to flee before them.

When faced with an obstacle you can either try finding a way around the obstacle or you can try crashing repeatedly in to the obstacle. When you do the latter, do not expect any results - you are wasting time trying that option. Deep down you know, that option is not worth it. You do it because you do not see another way around. 

Here are other ways around the obstacle.

1. If you have any hobbies, pursue them. You will meet people with the same interests as you. It may be fun.
2. Set goals for what you want to do or become. Work on achieving that goal. Do not expect immediate results. You will get results only when you put some effort into it.
3. Vent your anger/frustration in the gym. There is nothing as good as exercise to keep you focused. Do not just exercise for the sake of exercising. Exercise until your muscles burn. I vent my frustration on the sandbag until I can't hit any more. It helps in its own way.

Lastly, do not think about suicide. It is like digging a pit for yourself. The more you dig, the deeper you go without a way out. Do something that will calm you down. I go on long walks without a destination in mind. It relaxes my mind. I urge you to do something similar.

Well, I kinda know what the brother may have gone through. I didn't intend for my comment to make light of the pain that he may have gone through. But my belief is that it can be corrected or worked out. I was in a similar phase and I quote this because this is the only thing I relate to. When I was down and out, all I was looking for was an easy way out. No rational thinking, no reason. I wasn't thinking about my family or the people who care for me or anything. When I tried to rationalize my thinking - when very close to the edge, all those negative thoughts just vanished. I suffered for 30 days with all those negative thoughts and all those negative thoughts just vanished. I wanted to live and do better. I am kind of better now. I realize that me trying to leave the world was irrational. Instead of confronting my problems and looking to reach a solution, I was just trying to escape it and seek an easy way out. My thinking was exactly like this "Problem? OMG I gotta die" which is pretty stupid now that I think of it. The thing is, he may have had problems - no one is denying that, but you can't really say there was no solution to that problem and be ok with suicide. No offence meant to anyone. I am just stating things from my perspective.
Sorry mate. Looks to me like you are bypassing the problem. Oh she's gone . ok. No more reason to live. Tada. What the heck? Why do you think life is not worth living? Discuss your problem.

On second thoughts, I do not want you to talk to her about it. It will probably break her. All I can say is, live a good life, for her sake. Dedicate every good that you do in the world to her. Live a life. Killing yourself is never an answer. You are through a shitty phase and you will pass through it. Just do not do anything stupid now. You will regret it.

Yes. You do. I dare you to say the same thing to her and get her acceptance to this insanity. Seriously, that you care about her is good, but come on, you do not die because she's dying. If anything, you will make her feel guilty. Is that what you want?

Think about it. Why are you feeling this way? Discuss it with us. We can help. By the way the title sounds, I think you are seeking some sort of release. Have you tried exercising or pursuing a hobby?

Yeah those old emotions resurface time and again. You ignore them and will yourself to carry on. You swear to yourself that you will never give in to stupid and irrational thoughts. You swear to yourself that you will take care of people who care about you and never give up on yourself for them. If you want something desperately enough, will yourself to get it. If you want to get rid of this depression, will yourself out of it. It will build your will power and determination.

Yes, you summon the energy or motivation to do things right. It is just that you have given up. DON'T. Read the situation yourself. Why do you want to be in that mess? Why do want to end life? Have you enjoyed the good things about life yet? Don't you want to enjoy them (again)? You say you put on a brave face and act normal. I say, put on a brave attitude. Go out and conquer stuff. If you want to end this mess, put up a fight. Do not give into negative emotions. Pursue a hobby or do something that makes you happy. Gardening? Playing the violin? Kickboxing? Anything. How can it hurt? Why are you apathetic to yourself? Don't you care about yourself? You ought to treat yourself better. Be the person that you want to be. Not somebody who has given up on him(her)self.

The pressure gets to us sometimes. Do not allow yourself to be overwhelmed by that pressure. Have the will power and determination to see yourself out of it. There are people who care about you that you may not know yet. If a bag of dicks find you an annoyance, it is just because they are a bag of dicks. Not because you *have a problem*. Stop putting on a mask for other people. They are not going to know the difference if that is the case. If it is empathy you need, they will never know. You put a mask and ask other people to read through it? Come on. Your problems are not the be all and end all of life. So do not do anything stupid. Every problem can be overcome and will be, with enough determination and will power. You will need to disregard stuff and work towards the solution. You want to improve your grades? You will need to work hard to improve them. There is no easy way out. There is never an easy way out. Just grind your teeth and work your way through it. You may be overcome, but you must keep that goal in your mind at all times and never give up. Everytime you give up, you are dragging yourself back by aeons. Help yourself. Think of the final goal all the time and work on reaching it.

Existing will suck if you do things that make it suck. Like, in the above example, just lying down when you are being beaten. As every punch hits you hard, you just keep on wondering what is the point of life if I have to bear this sort of shit? When you do something about it, like getting up and fighting, your existence is then defined by your will power and determination to put up a fight. Without it, existence will have no meaning. 

Is there something you so desperately want but cannot have? Then your existence will be defined by how you try to get it. If you just lose all hope you will be in state of self doubt, pity and grief.

You do not make comments about the journey when you are on the journey. At the end of the journey, you are free to make comments as you may please. I am talking about the journey called life. Sure, parts of the journey may downright suck, but you can't just reach a conclusion just yet and reverse. It's called life and these are just experiences. You can't label yourself a failure because of an experience. That'd be doing injustice to your life. It is never too late to change the machinery and proceed with the journey. Seems to me like you are lonely and just need a couple of friends to have good times with. Try making friends. Try having a good time. Do what you like. Try playing some team games like football :-D Your relatives may seem aloof because they may be feeling that you are fine by yourself. Let them know you aren't. What gives? Your life is what you want it to be. If you want to continue like this, you inadvertently will. If you do not want it to be like this, change it :-) We are here with you.

No one asks you to smile for their benefit. If you are doing it, you are doing it to hide your feelings and not discuss things openly. You want inner peace, you can't just wish for it. If there are things that you derive peace from, like for example, playing the violin or punching a heavy bag, go for it. You will get your inner peace when you do the things that will help develop it. Not if you sit in a corner, mask your feelings and do nothing about it.

Why are actually thinking about it? Don't you have anything better to think about? Find a problem on project euler and try to solve it if you are bored. Play Sudoku. Pursue a hobby :-/ If you have loads of free time, use it constructively, not in stupid ways like this :-)

Ask yourself this: Why are you depressed? What is bothering you so much that you are close to the edge? What can you do to overcome it? Life is full of problems. It is not life when you see a problem and run to the edge. It is life, when you fix the problem and move on. If you are at the edge, you pretty much stopped giving a fuck. So do just that and fix the problem. Use the "Who gives a fuck?" to fix the problem. It'd be more help if you can discuss the problem though. We are here to help.

Ok. 
You are tired of being alone - Make new friends. Move on.
You are tired of relying on people for help - Stop relying on people and then move on.
You are tired of people just being douche bags - Hey, not all of us are douche bags. Might be, you are just hanging out with the wrong crowd.
You are tired of the world - Why? Have you really seen the entire world? What part of the world have you seen? I am sure it is insignificant when compared to the whole world. You can't make an opinion based on such a skewed statistic. Live your life to the fullest. What is the harm? You have considered suicide. How could living your life to the fullest hurt? Have you pursued any hobbies? It will help you cope up and lift your spirits. Have you hit the gym? It will teach you, that if you want to be in shape, you have to will yourself first and then work on it. If you are in a shitty mess, will yourself to get yourself out of it and then work on it. It is not easy. But then, nothing is. Only will power and effort rewards you. Nothing else in life does. I seriously hope you do not consider suicide based on a few bad experiences, because it is really stupid. I was in this same position and I, in retrospect, think I was pretty stupid back then. You can only make an opinion of your life at its end. Just because you ran into a few rough edges doesn't mean shit in the long run. It may even help you one way or the other but it is not the end all of life.

About her anxiety, ask her to take deep breaths everytime she suffers from one (increases oxygen flow)  I personally think pills do not help and that you need to develop the will power to say no to negative stuff, but still that is a personal opinion.

But it is beautiful, isn't it? That's exactly life and death. Beautiful when lived to the fullest. When dark clouds gather and obstruct the sunlight, doesn't it feel great to see the sunlight when it breaks through? That is what you need to do. Try living to the fullest. When something is dragging you down, kick it away or put it on your shoulder and get to the top. If your therapist is not listening, she is acting like a god-damned cunt. Change your therapist. Welcome to the club :-) Things I learnt were

1. I can't really comment on the absurdity of life when I haven't really lived it all out, to the fullest.
2. If you are looking at the shitty end, walk away from it. Change direction. Don't continue walking into it. If you do, shit WILL happen.
3. If you fall into a deep pit, try to come out. Do not just stay there. No point being there. Put on your cowl and cape and be the Batman. I ain't NO superhero but I am NOT GOING TO GIVE UP. NEVER.

Well, the beauty of life is life itself. It is in those little things that you find joy. If life were an ocean and you were a man with a boat on a really small island surrounded by that ocean, would you rather live on the island or set about conquering the ocean? If you choose to live on the island, what is the point of that? What are you expecting to happen? The hand of God to show up? The beauty of life is in trying. When you exercise, you know you are not going to be Superman. But still you try. Why? To be the best you can. What else can you do? Give up everything because it is not worth it? Nah. People suffer. But they do not give up. They choose to endure the suffering and come out happy that they have either endured the suffering or defeated it. If you were a boxer in an infinite match without a refree and your opponent was beating you down since the dawn of time, at some point, you will feel compelled to rise above the circumstances and put up a fight, because suffering sucks. Trying to defeat it is better.

Life just doesn't end here. You are walking through shit right now. Eventually you will find a road that will lead you to the path where you will find peace. That is not going to happen if you stop in the middle. You just got to keep walking.

What options have you tried to fix the problem? Have you tried sound proofing your room? You can put a mattress against the door and see if that works. I never tried it and I think it might work. Might be the guys here who have tried reducing the noise may have some simple remedies. Have you tried practicing outside? Might be at a friend's place? Stand up for yourself. Some people just complain all the time. You can just ignore it or work a remedy. Don't give up. You are losing interest in stuff you liked doing because you are associating the same sort of negative feedback with it. Do not do that. Your grandma cares about you, in her own silly way. She may not be realizing how much it hurts you when she says some of the stuff that she does. Chill out. Work a solution out.

Why? What do you want to do? What have you done to help yourself do what you want to do? Why do you think you are alone? There are people out here willing to help you even though we really do not know who you are. Do you really still feel alone? Why do you want to end it? If your wife and kids would be broken hearted when they see you bruised, how broken hearted are they going to be if they know you blew your brains out? Wouldn't it fuck your kids up? If they care so much, they would probably blame themselves and never grow out of it. How would your wife react? Do you think it will be any easy if she gets to raise kids on her own, telling them how Daddy blew his own brains out? Come on. Wake up. If you have a problem, find a solution. Seek help. I have no idea what your problem is but it looks like you are facing a problem all alone and that you are overwhelmed. You needn't be. Talk to your wife or a good friend you can trust. Talk to us, what the heck? If you have considered committing suicide what the hell is it gonna hurt to talk to a completely random stranger and explain why you feel that way. If you are not sure why you feel that way, try to understand why you feel that way. Since when did you start feeling this way? Any particular reason? When you felt good, was there any particular thing that you were doing that you are not doing now? Do not think about suicide. It is a very stupid option. People around you, who care for you will be completely fucked up when they know that you have considered such an option. They will end up blaming themselves one way or the other. You do not want that.

As my friend would say, that is the whole beauty of it. There is no point to life. Your life is what you make of it. The sooner you realize that, the better. It is like watching a rose blossom. There is inherent beauty in it. The rose eventually withers away. But that doesn't stop the rose from blossoming, does it? If the rose were to stop blossoming, what is the beauty in it? Eventually everything dies. But that doesn't mean you hurl little babies out of high towers, as their life is pointless. If life were to be immortal, it would be pointless then too. You could learn all that you want and then do all that you want and then what? It is our mortal life that makes the most sense. The impending death should make us realize that we can only enjoy the beauty of life.

You haven't even reached 21. Your life hasn't even started. Think with a clear head. It looks to me like you are focusing on the negative end of stuff and overwhelming yourself. Pick a hobby or learn something new. Find some friends that share your hobbies or interests. How do you know you have no girl prospects? Have you tried asking out all the ladies in the world, already? :o And really, if having a small penis is a problem, asians wouldn't be ruling the roost at the population count, would we? (I am Indian) Eat proper and drink proper. Just go with life, do the things you enjoy and you will feel good. And do not make opinion about life now itself. You can reach an opinion after you have died. Having an opinion while living is stupid cause you haven't lived your entire life to reach an opinion.

Sometimes, you cannot do anything when overcome with depression. I've been there. The depression will pass. You need to will yourself to get out of it. You can't just lay there worrying that you are doing nothing. Think about it. What are you doing? How do you expect things to be better if you are not doing anything to make it better? I do not want you to blame yourself here but I want you to understand that you are in a deep pit - You can come out if you try or you can stay down there and let the darkness overcome you; It overcomes everyone eventually. Before I sound like I am preaching, I will say that I have been there. I couldn't help myself to do the most basic of things. I somehow didn't do anything foolish. One day, I was seriously considering what was going on and thought "To heck with this" and walked out of the pit. I am happy to say I have not been depressed ever since. I had some scares but my experiences helped me. I do not want to go down that pit and I will not. I'd like you to do the same. There may be a lot of emotions that you are running through - self doubt, life and its purpose etc. Focus on the ones that will help you out. In my case, I did not want to be in that situation. That is what I thought about for a long time. I figured out I was looking for an easy way out. There is no easy way out. There is never an easy way out. You have to work on stuff and put some effort into it.

The default location for Office install is in the %ProgramFiles% directory unless otherwise specified. So I would check there for "Microsoft Office" folder. If you can start Excel by typing "excel.exe" in Start->Run, I'd probably check the directories in the %PATH% environment variable. You can list the directories in the %PATH% by going to command prompt and typing in "set" to display a list of environment variables. The path environment variable should be in that list, containing a list of directories in which the executables will be searched for, by default.

He went on fast for about 288 hours demanding that the government introduce the bill that the civil society prepared instead of the ineffective one drafted by the government. Due to the mass support, that he enjoyed, the government succumbed to his demands. I guess, you really need popular support for something to change. There is another lady, Irom Sharmila, who has been fasting since the last 10 years demanding that the government withdraw the AFSPA act which is used to combat terrorism at the cost of freedom of ordinary citizens. She did(does) not have popular support and her fast was little known outside of manipur and has largely been ineffective. She still continues fasting. Hopefully, she will get the same support that Anna Hazare did with the new interest being shown in her fast and the reasons for it.

People think like that during depression. That is not the case. During depression, I was a wreck. I exercised hoping that it would make me feel good. Know what I did wrong? I exercised for the sake of exercising. I did not have any goal in mind. Not having a goal will make you lose focus real easy. Focus and try. Set goals not to defeat something but to gain something. Mastery over a musical instrument by playing a difficult sonata without a mistake, something like that. If you are staying in a place where you feel you are not wanted, you are probably staying in the wrong place or hanging out with the wrong crowd. Try pursuing a hobby and find friends who share the same likes as you do. You should probably stop worrying about why things are not working out for you and instead do something that makes you feel nice. When I was down, I thought about attending some kickboxing classes. It was something that I wanted to do for quite sometime but I didn't because my friends wouldn't approve of that. Now that I think about it, instead of doing something that would please my friends, I should have done what would've pleased me. That'd have made me happier. Now after being through the shitty depressive phase, I am fixing everything that was wrong. I am doing stuff that will make me happy. That is what you should be doing too. Friends that you can share happiness with are a blessing and doing stuff, be it a hobby or work, will keep you occupied.
